_doc: Venue registry for the events extraction agent (scripts/ingest-venue-events.ts). Each venue whose events live only on its own site/socials gets an entry. The agent fetches `urls`, has Claude extract upcoming events (title, date/time, description, price, ticket url) with source + freshness, dedupes against what's known, and writes src/data/venue-events.json — which flows into the events feed + the answer engine. Venues with empty `urls` are skipped. Add the venue's official events/calendar page URL(s). Social-only venues (Instagram/Facebook) need the partnership/vision path (see docs/EXTRACTION_PLATFORM.md), not blind scraping.
